matches.rationale: Finding 2 identifies the same defect in the logits fusion mechanism: the claim that weights sum to 1 is inconsistent with how they are defined. The ground truth notes the formula conflicts with the balancing principle, and the finding correctly observes that λ_v^t + λ_c^t cannot sum to 1 given the attention distribution includes query tokens. Both point to the same inconsistency in Eq. (11) and surrounding text in Section 4.2.

Finding 1 discusses a training-free vs. training contradiction between abstract and method sections, which is unrelated to causal masking in attention reallocation. Finding 2 addresses logits fusion weight normalization, not causal mask preservation. Neither finding implicates the attention reallocation formulas or causal masking issues described in gt_id 2.
